phase1_initial_proposals.technology_reasoning: The superconducting MRI machine with a closed-bore magnet design dominates the global diagnostic imaging market due to its superior magnetic field strength (usually 1.5T or 3.0T) and image quality. This design is the industry standard adopted by nearly all major MRI manufacturers as of 2024, characterized by its large, cryogenically cooled superconducting magnet and complex RF and gradient subsystems.
